issues.on_page: Total Resources Available 76,345.92 - line 5 subtotal 27,209.96 = 49,135.96 (includes transfers in 26,804.97)
issues.issue: Budget/waiver-form rule says receipts total = Total Resources Available minus line 5 subtotal (49,135.96, includes ["transfers_in"]). The extractor also took out transfers in (22,330.99, includes []). The figure is consistent and marked computed, but it doesn't follow the stated rule.

On dissolution the village sent its remaining balance to the Harlan County Treasurer. Treating this as spending in 'other' is defensible, but it is more than half of the outflows and is really a handover of the balance to another government, not operating spending. No decision_needed entry asks whether it should be spending or other financing.
